mapper.select: WITH current_chapter AS ( SELECT c.id AS chapter_id, c.row_version AS chapter_row_version, c.source_hash, c.current_storyboard_revision_id, p.id AS project_id, p.name AS project_name FROM chapters c JOIN story_versions sv ON sv.id = c.story_version_id JOIN projects p ON p.id = sv.project_id WHERE c.id = #{chapterId} AND p.id = #{projectId} ), current_revision AS ( SELECT cc.*, sr.id AS revision_id, sr.source_hash AS storyboard_source_hash FROM current_chapter cc LEFT JOIN storyboard_revisions sr ON sr.id = cc.current_storyboard_revision_id ), scene_stats AS ( SELECT COUNT(s.id)::int AS scene_count, COALESCE(SUM(s.duration_seconds), 0)::bigint AS duration_seconds FROM current_revision cr LEFT JOIN scenes s ON s.chapter_id = cr.chapter_id AND s.storyboard_revision_id = cr.revision_id AND s.status <> 'OUTDATED' ), beat_stats AS ( SELECT COUNT(vb.id)::int AS visual_beat_count FROM current_revision cr LEFT JOIN scenes s ON s.chapter_id = cr.chapter_id AND s.storyboard_revision_id = cr.revision_id AND s.status <> 'OUTDATED' LEFT JOIN visual_beats vb ON vb.scene_id = s.id ), approval_state AS ( SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM current_revision cr JOIN scenes s ON s.chapter_id = cr.chapter_id AND s.storyboard_revision_id = cr.revision_id WHERE s.status = 'APPROVED' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visual_beats vb WHERE vb.scene_id = s.id AND vb.review_status = 'APPROVED') ) AS has_approved_output ), current_media_job AS ( SELECT cr.*, gj.id AS media_generation_job_id, gj.job_id AS media_generation_job_key, gj.media_plan_id, gj.media_plan_revision, gj.status AS media_generation_status FROM current_revision cr LEFT JOIN chapter_media_heads cmh ON cmh.chapter_id = cr.chapter_id LEFT JOIN generation_jobs gj ON gj.id = cmh.generation_job_id AND gj.chapter_id = cr.chapter_id AND gj.job_type IN ('IMAGE_GENERATE','SHOT_IMAGE_GENERATE') AND gj.chapter_row_version = cr.chapter_row_version AND gj.source_hash = cr.source_hash AND gj.storyboard_revision_id = cr.revision_id AND gj.media_plan_id IS NOT NULL AND gj.media_plan_revision IS NOT NULL ), latest_analysis AS ( SELECT gj.status, gj.source_hash, CASE WHEN gj.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN gj.updated_at ELSE NULL END AS completed_at FROM current_chapter cc LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT gj.status, gj.source_hash, gj.updated_at FROM generation_jobs gj WHERE gj.chapter_id = cc.chapter_id AND gj.job_type = 'CHAPTER_ANALYZE' AND gj.source_hash = cc.source_hash AND gj.chapter_row_version = cc.chapter_row_version ORDER BY gj.created_at DESC, gj.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) gj ON TRUE ), visual_generation AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN cmj.media_generation_job_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END::int AS total, CASE WHEN cmj.media_generation_status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END::int AS completed, CASE WHEN cmj.media_generation_status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END::int AS failed, CASE WHEN cmj.media_generation_status = 'RUNNING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END::int AS running, CASE WHEN cmj.media_generation_status = 'QUEUED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END::int AS queued, CASE WHEN cmj.media_generation_status = 'STALLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END::int AS stalled, CASE WHEN cmj.media_generation_status = 'UNKNOWN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END::int AS unknown, CASE WHEN cmj.media_generation_status = 'PAUSED_COST_LIMIT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END::int AS paused FROM current_media_job cmj ), latest_narration AS ( SELECT na.id AS narration_asset_id, op.status AS job_status, pa.storage_key AS narration_storage_key, na.duration_ms AS narration_duration_ms, CASE WHEN na.id IS NOT NULL THEN na.created_at ELSE NULL END AS completed_at FROM current_chapter cc LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT nr.id FROM narration_requests nr WHERE nr.chapter_id = cc.chapter_id AND nr.chapter_row_version = cc.chapter_row_version AND nr.source_hash = cc.source_hash ORDER BY nr.created_at DESC, nr.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) nr ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT gj.status AS status FROM narration_operations no JOIN generation_jobs gj ON gj.id = no.generation_job_id WHERE no.narration_request_id = nr.id ORDER BY no.created_at DESC, no.generation_job_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) op ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT na.id, na.created_at, na.project_asset_id, na.duration_ms FROM narration_assets na WHERE na.narration_request_id = nr.id ORDER BY na.created_at DESC, na.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) na ON TRUE LEFT JOIN project_assets pa ON pa.id = na.project_asset_id ), latest_render_manifest AS ( SELECT rm.id, rm.created_at FROM current_media_job cmj LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT rm.id, rm.created_at FROM render_manifests rm WHERE rm.chapter_id = cmj.chapter_id AND rm.chapter_row_version = cmj.chapter_row_version AND rm.source_hash = cmj.source_hash AND rm.media_plan_id = cmj.media_plan_id AND rm.media_plan_revision = cmj.media_plan_revision ORDER BY rm.created_at DESC, rm.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) rm ON TRUE ), latest_render_artifact AS ( SELECT fa.id AS artifact_id, fa.generation_job_id, fa.status AS artifact_status, CASE WHEN fa.status = 'READY' THEN COALESCE(fa.updated_at, fa.created_at) ELSE NULL END AS completed_at FROM latest_render_manifest lrm LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT fa.id, fa.generation_job_id, fa.status, fa.updated_at, fa.created_at FROM final_artifacts fa WHERE fa.render_manifest_id = lrm.id AND fa.artifact_type = 'CHAPTER_VIDEO' AND fa.status <> 'ARCHIVED' ORDER BY fa.created_at DESC, fa.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) fa ON TRUE ), latest_render_job AS ( SELECT gj.id AS generation_job_id, gj.job_id AS job_id, gj.status AS job_status FROM current_media_job cmj LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT gj.id, gj.job_id, gj.status FROM generation_jobs gj WHERE gj.id = (SELECT generation_job_id FROM latest_render_artifact) OR (gj.chapter_id = cmj.chapter_id AND gj.job_type IN ('CHAPTER_RENDER','RENDER_PROJECT','RENDER_SHORT') AND gj.chapter_row_version = cmj.chapter_row_version AND gj.source_hash = cmj.source_hash AND gj.media_plan_id = cmj.media_plan_id AND gj.media_plan_revision = cmj.media_plan_revision) ORDER BY CASE WHEN gj.id = (SELECT generation_job_id FROM latest_render_artifact) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, gj.created_at DESC, gj.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) gj ON TRUE ) SELECT cc.project_name, ss.scene_count, bs.visual_beat_count, ss.duration_seconds, cr.storyboard_source_hash, aps.has_approved_output, la.status AS analysis_status, la.source_hash AS analysis_source_hash, la.completed_at AS analysis_completed_at, vg.total AS visual_generation_total, vg.completed AS visual_generation_completed, vg.failed AS visual_generation_failed, vg.running AS visual_generation_running, vg.queued AS visual_generation_queued, vg.stalled AS visual_generation_stalled, vg.unknown AS visual_generation_unknown, vg.paused AS visual_generation_paused, cmj.media_generation_job_key AS visual_generation_latest_job_id, cmj.media_plan_id AS visual_generation_media_plan_id, cmj.media_plan_revision AS visual_generation_media_plan_revision, (SELECT narration_asset_id IS NOT NULL FROM latest_narration) AS narration_asset_ready, (SELECT job_status FROM latest_narration) AS narration_job_status, (SELECT completed_at FROM latest_narration) AS narration_completed_at, (SELECT narration_storage_key FROM latest_narration) AS narration_storage_key, (SELECT narration_duration_ms FROM latest_narration) AS narration_duration_ms, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM latest_render_manifest WHERE id IS NOT NULL) AS render_manifest_created, (SELECT artifact_status FROM latest_render_artifact) AS render_artifact_status, (SELECT job_status FROM latest_render_job) AS render_job_status, (SELECT job_id FROM latest_render_job) AS render_job_id, (SELECT artifact_id FROM latest_render_artifact) AS render_artifact_id, (SELECT completed_at FROM latest_render_artifact) AS render_completed_at FROM current_chapter cc CROSS JOIN current_revision cr CROSS JOIN current_media_job cmj CROSS JOIN scene_stats ss CROSS JOIN beat_stats bs CROSS JOIN visual_generation vg CROSS JOIN approval_state aps LEFT JOIN latest_analysis la ON TRUE

SELECT s.id, s.order_index, s.title, s.duration_seconds, s.status, COUNT(vb.id)::int AS visual_beat_count, (array_agg(pa.url ORDER BY vb.order_index, vb.id) FILTER (WHERE pa.url IS NOT NULL))[1] AS preview_image_url FROM chapters c JOIN scenes s ON s.storyboard_revision_id = c.current_storyboard_revision_id LEFT JOIN visual_beats vb ON vb.scene_id = s.id LEFT JOIN project_assets pa ON pa.id = vb.preview_asset_id AND pa.project_id = #{projectId} AND pa.asset_type = 'IMAGE' AND pa.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE c.id = #{chapterId} AND s.status <> 'OUTDATED' GROUP BY s.id, s.order_index, s.title, s.duration_seconds, s.status ORDER BY s.order_index ASC, s.id ASC LIMIT 4
